$notOffered.multiselect: No longer offered in the builder (decided 4 Nov 2026), so it has no question page. Form files that have it still render and submit, as Checkboxes do: see the form file page.

short.name: a short answer
short.storedNote: Text isn't trimmed: `" Demo "` is stored as `" Demo "`.
short.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is text, matched exactly: case and spaces count.

long.name: a long answer
long.sends: the text exactly as typed, line breaks included
long.storedNote: Text isn't trimmed, and it's at most 20,000 characters.

email.name: an email question
email.storedNote: The address's form is checked on the trimmed text, and the stored text keeps its spaces.
email.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is text, matched exactly: case and spaces count.

validator.intro: This one refuses the clinic's own addresses:
validator.message: Enter your own email address, not the clinic's.

phone.name: a phone number question
phone.storedNote: The number's form is checked on the trimmed text, and the stored text keeps its spaces.
phone.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is text, matched exactly: case and spaces count.

link.name: a link question
link.storedNote: The address's form is checked on the trimmed text, and the stored text keeps its spaces.
link.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is text, matched exactly: case and spaces count.

number.name: a number question
number.storedNote: A plain decimal string, such as `"3"`, is also accepted, and stored as the number `3`.

validator.intro: The builder's Minimum and Maximum already check the range. This one asks for a whole number:

date.name: a date question
date.storedNote: It must be a real calendar date: `2026-02-30` is refused.
date.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is a date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, matched exactly.

validator.intro: This one refuses a date of birth after today:
validator.message: Date of birth can't be in the future.

time.name: a time question
time.storedNote: Your server also accepts `HH:MM:SS`, from `00:00` to `23:59`, and stores it as sent.
time.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is a time, matched exactly as text, so `09:30` doesn't match `09:30:00`.

validator.intro: This one keeps the time within the clinic's opening hours:

scale.name: a linear scale
scale.sends: the chosen point, as a number
scale.storedNote: A plain decimal string, such as `"4"`, is also accepted, and stored as the number `4`.

rating.name: a rating
rating.storedNote: A plain decimal string, such as `"5"`, is also accepted, and stored as the number `5`.

country.name: a Respondent's country question
country.storedNote: The name must be one of `COUNTRIES`, exported from `@zoworkhq/zoforms/core`.
country.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is a country's name, exactly as in `COUNTRIES`.

choice.name: a multiple choice question
choice.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is an option's code.

dropdown.name: a dropdown
dropdown.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is an option's code.

validator.intro: This one takes only the referrals the clinic books online:
validator.message: Call the front desk to book this referral.

checkbox.name: a checkboxes question
checkbox.sends: the ticked options' codes, in the order chosen
checkbox.storedNote: The options keep the order they were sent in.
checkbox.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is an option's code, and it passes when that option is among those ticked.

validator.intro: This one asks for at least two days:

ranking.name: a ranking
ranking.sends: the ranked options' codes, in ranked order
ranking.storedNote: The options keep the order they were sent in, so the first is ranked 1.
ranking.conditionAnswer: The condition's `answer` is an option's code, and it passes when that option is ranked, in any place.

matrix.name: a matrix
matrix.sends: each answered row's code, with its chosen column's code
matrix.storedNote: Only answered rows are listed, in the form's order.

grid.name: a grid
grid.sends: each answered row's code, with its answered cells by column code
grid.storedNote: Only answered rows and cells are listed, in the form's order. A choice cell is stored with its option's label, and a text cell as its text.
